title: Write a practical operating procedure
description: Document purpose, prerequisites, ordered steps, checks, exceptions and escalation.
accomplishes: Document purpose, prerequisites, ordered steps, checks, exceptions and escalation. Separate actions from approval requirements and identify the source of each rule. Do not invent organisation policy or assume permission to perform the procedure.
prompt:
Act as a planning facilitator.

Task: Write a practical operating procedure.

Input context:
- PROCESS: [PROCESS]
- RESPONSIBLE ROLES: [RESPONSIBLE ROLES]
- INPUTS: [INPUTS]
- EXCEPTIONS: [EXCEPTIONS]

Document purpose, prerequisites, ordered steps, checks, exceptions and escalation. Separate actions from approval requirements and identify the source of each rule. Do not invent organisation policy or assume permission to perform the procedure.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Import-review procedure
Confirm the file source, validate required columns and inspect duplicate warnings. Save only approved records and retain rejection reasons. Escalate unclear ownership rather than overwriting data. Record the review reference and outcome. This is a draft SOP needing process-owner approval; no import has been executed and no internal policy is asserted as official.
